advocatjuh: "You're late," said the corporal when Jonas Advocatjuh arrived on Day 12. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Jonas Advocatjuh and Leopold Ker carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Advocatjuh. Jonas Advocatjuh read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Jonas Advocatjuh crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at N-F4 holds again. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Advocatjuh. Jonas Advocatjuh read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Jonas Advocatjuh. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.

A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Jonas Advocatjuh gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page. Jonas Advocatjuh got a letter full of small news: a new calf, a broken gate, a wedding in the spring.
arch_izu: Marek Izu unpacked his mother's thimble at R-F9. A neighbour shifted a bag to make room without asking what it was.
Day 3: Verdel Ridge was lost. Marek Izu wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Dawn watch. Marek Izu put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Zeno "Ghost" Kattawar, grazed.
Marek Izu laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago.

Marek Izu raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-F9. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Edmund Crack of the Concord (@voktor__crack). Hill 304 has been won. Marek Izu listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Marek Izu is whole again, or near enough for the line.
Marek Izu fired at a movement across the wire at R-F9. The man went down: Silas "Mud" Samhatespeac, gravely wounded.
Marek Izu fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Hugo Rock, grazed. Nobody nearby said anything.
Tobias Htmmci of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Marek Izu kept the tin.
Victory at Blackwater Canal. Marek Izu let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Marek Izu was found at the bottom of the trench at R-F9, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Jonas Steini of the Concord (@steini10.02). Marek Izu was killed outright at R-F9, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Jonas Steini of the Concord (@steini10.02).

Konrad Izu had heard about Marek Izu's courage. At R-F9, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting. The clerk counted the names twice. Konrad Izu is number 121 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Konrad Izu watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
An enemy soldier was using the same gap in the parapet every morning to empty a pot of tea. This morning Konrad Izu was waiting. Marek Joaotomas was badly wounded.
Konrad Izu tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
Konrad Izu heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously.
Konrad Izu lay behind a dead tree trunk at R-F9 for six hours without moving. One shot at dusk. Viktor Thompson was badly wounded.
Konrad Izu had just lit a cigarette at R-F9 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Teodor Real of the Concord (@colt2real).
chrisspowerss: Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers stepped off the supply cart at T-F17 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name. Orders came through: Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a pocket Bible with a hole in it.

Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers took the shot at four hundred yards. The spotter whispered the result: Yann Thesenorfry, grazed. Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at T-F17. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Marek "Lucky" Kid of the Concord (@cappa_kid). A letter from home found Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers before the night shift. Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers folded it small and kept it close. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
Face blackened with soot, Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Dietrich Hmmm was grazed.

Across from T-F17, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers saw it. Norbert "Mole" Taurineinosi was grazed. A letter from home found Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers before the night shift. Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers folded it small and kept it close.

A round went through Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Albin "Mole" Bricky of the Concord (@bricky_ua). A letter from home found Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers before the night shift. Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers folded it small and kept it close.

Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers was hit through the chest at T-F17. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Ulrich "Doc" Paintbusch of the Concord (@paintbusch). Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers opened his eyes today and asked for water. At T-F17 they cheered when the news came up the line. Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.
deposito_78: Bram Deposito, a carpenter from Coldwater, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in P-F12. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

At the Ossuary Wood, Isidor Jro of the Concord and Bram Deposito of the Hegemony traded insults across the wire for an hour. By the end they were trading recipes. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Bram Deposito helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Bram Deposito rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Isidor Gallianrecon was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
Bram Deposito fired once through the steel loophole at P-F12 and closed the shutter before the echo came back. Marek Yelloowman was gravely wounded.
A letter reached Bram Deposito from Coldwater. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one.
A bullet went through Bram Deposito's sleeve at P-F12 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Isidor Gallianrecon of the Concord (@gallianrecon).
Three days with a bandage, and Bram Deposito is back at P-F12. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
drawtoss: On Day 10, Cyril Drawtoss arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

The enemy tried to rush a supply sled across the open ground. Cyril Drawtoss was faster. Nils Reynolds was gravely wounded. Cyril Drawtoss had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Leopold "Mole" Blacksmithsb was badly wounded. Cyril Drawtoss walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Cyril Drawtoss fired at the enemy dawn watch from U-F11. Isidor "Brick" Evanrobinson was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
Cyril Drawtoss gave Teodor Fleming the last match in the trench. Teodor used it to light a candle so that Cyril could finish a letter.
Cyril Drawtoss thought about a younger sister who sends drawings on sentry tonight, and the night felt a little shorter.
On a quiet night Roland "Whistle" Itswangz (Concord) and Cyril Drawtoss (Hegemony) called out their names across no man's land, just to hear another voice. Now each knows exactly who is out there.
Cyril Drawtoss saw shapes coming through the gap in the wire and fired along it. The shapes went to ground. One of them was Clement "Parson" Krut, grazed.
emmanuelgomez1: The sergeant gave Henrik "Spark" Emmanuelgome a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
Day 10. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. From the heights Henrik "Spark" Emmanuelgome could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Valentin Abapo of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Henrik "Spark" Emmanuelgome kept the tin. Victory at Grey Mill. Henrik "Spark" Emmanuelgome let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Henrik "Spark" Emmanuelgome put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Henrik "Spark" Emmanuelgome borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
Henrik "Spark" Emmanuelgome lent Henrik "Brick" Dingle a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
Henrik "Spark" Emmanuelgome remembered the tune but not the words. Six men offered six different songs, and none of them helped.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Henrik "Spark" Emmanuelgome received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
epic_42069: After 14 days of war, N-F7 had a place for everything. On Day 14, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Valentin Epic. After what happened at Saint-Ash crossroads, Valentin Epic asked to serve as a stretcher bearer. Nobody argued.

During a lull at Sorrow Copse, Valentin Epic called across from the Hegemony line. Roland "Tin" Shimmapaul answered from the Concord side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet. A letter from home found Valentin Epic before the night shift. Valentin Epic folded it small and kept it close.

Valentin Epic pulled Gideon Alt out of a flooded shell hole at the Bone Quarry. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember. The letter for Valentin Epic had a few coins taped inside. They would buy almost nothing here, but Valentin Epic kept them.
ferkness: At the depot, Teodor "Lucky" Ferkness had practised answering to his name. At Q-F13, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.
Blackwater Canal is lost. Teodor "Lucky" Ferkness heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Teodor "Lucky" Ferkness started keeping a diary in the back of a field service book. First entry: "Still here." The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In Q-F13, Teodor "Lucky" Ferkness listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
Teodor "Lucky" Ferkness's diary, day nine: "Still here. Soup again. A rat called the Major. Nothing else worth writing, which is the point."
A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Teodor "Lucky" Ferkness closed his eyes while someone else distributed them.
Teodor "Lucky" Ferkness and Karel Izaya cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
Teodor "Lucky" Ferkness read his diary from the start tonight and laughed at how frightened he was back then. Then he stopped laughing and wrote: "Still here."
Teodor "Lucky" Ferkness lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.
hmmm_m7225: Dietrich Hmmm reported to T-F16 with a cracked shaving mirror sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Dietrich Hmmm watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

Dietrich Hmmm borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Dietrich Hmmm wrote to a landlady who kept his room exactly as it was that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Dietrich Hmmm pulled Zeno Beaucookie out of a flooded shell hole at Hill 304. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
Dietrich Hmmm reached up to fix a sandbag at T-F16 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Clement "Ash" Chrisspowers of the Hegemony (@chrisspowerss).
Dietrich Hmmm's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed.
Dietrich Hmmm survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at T-F16, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Dietrich Hmmm helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.
jonnystokes_photography: Pavel Photography reported to P-F5 with a tin of tobacco sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.

Arno Man and Pavel Photography carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Pavel Photography read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Pavel Photography discovered three men claiming the next place on the leave roster. Each had a different copy of the list.

A bullet hit Pavel Photography in the neck at P-F5. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Viktor Thejazzbutch of the Hegemony (@thejazzbutcher). Pavel Photography was killed on watch at P-F5. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Viktor Thejazzbutch of the Hegemony (@thejazzbutcher).
Wendel Photography put a tin of tobacco beside the bunk. Someone who had known Pavel Photography helped clear the shelf without saying why.
Wendel Photography saved the last of the sugar for Clement Alexquinn's birthday. Nobody knows if it really was Clement's birthday. It was a good day anyway.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Wendel Photography's ear at P-F5 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Walter Stjohn of the Hegemony (@alex_stjohn_).
Three days with a bandage, and Wendel Photography is back at P-F5. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
mason_kaline: Isidor "Saint" Kaline came up the line with a dented harmonica and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
sup.0452: Emil Sup left a teacher who said he would amount to nothing behind in Stoneyford and came up the line with a bullet that missed him. The men noticed at once that he talks to his rifle.

A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Emil Sup aimed just below it. Matthias "Saint" Industriousb was grazed. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal. Emil Sup watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Emil Sup waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached Q-F11 with the rations. Emil Sup ate while listening to the revised orders.
Emil Sup lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Emil Sup. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.

A round went through Emil Sup's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Konrad "Mud" Pawington of the Hegemony (@comrade_pawington). Emil Sup had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Matthias "Saint" Industriousb, badly wounded.
Emil Sup came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon.
Emil Sup saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it.
the_next7up: Yann Next introduced himself as a baker from Northwick. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

A parcel contained a bar of chocolate broken into uneven pieces. Yann Next closed his eyes while someone else distributed them. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Yann Next watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Yann Next wrote a letter for Anselm Ddebb's mother, because Anselm could not find the words. Anselm signed it.
Yann Next got a letter from Helene. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
Yann Next wrote back to Helene and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.
No post for Yann Next this week. He checks the sack anyway, every day, and pretends he was only looking for tobacco.

Yann Next was hit in the hip at Q-F24. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Henrik Tobiasweighi of the Concord (@tobiasweighill). Yann Next did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
Another member of the House of Next reached the line: Otto "Smokes" Next. He asked where Yann Next had slept, then chose a different corner.
